text:
Maya: quick question  should the fallback operator inbox surface every fallback event or a compact sampled stream? thinking noise vs. postmortem needs
Sam: compact by default. show important ones expanded. ops shouldn't have to sift through thousands during a spike.
Owen: compact + retention windows for policy changes/canaries. how long do we keep entries for audit? 90d seems common.
Jess: UI suggestion: two sections  High severity (always shown) and Sampled (collapsible). filters: route, model, tenant, time.
Kai: do we include the full \"why_did_you_fallback\" blob inline? that can contain user content. maybe show a short tag + secure trace link.
Sam: agree  surface a summary_tag (e.g., \"latency_tail\", \"5xx_spike\", \"quota_exceeded\") and a trace_url that follows ACLs. example payload we can index:
{ "decision_id": "dec-20260322-02", "trigger": "latency_tail", "route": "/api/v1/stream", "fallback_chain": ["gptx-1","gptx-2"], "summary": "p95 latency > 1200ms over 30s" }
Owen: sampling proposal: 100% capture for severity>=high; 10% for medium; 0.5% for low. ensure minimum 1 event/min per route to keep a baseline. keeps index size manageable and meets most audit asks.
Maya: storage/cost concern: full traces are heavy. store minimal metadata in index and point to object storage for raw traces. stream raw to cold storage on-demand.
Kai: also redact user PII/content before persisting full traces by default. metadata includes input hashes + model version for deterministic replay.
Jess: operator actions: mute route, escalate to SRE, copy decision to clipboard, or trigger export. single-click actions preferred.
Sam: API changes: add fields: \"severity\", \"summary_tag\", \"trace_url\", \"decision_id\". provide /inbox endpoint with filter & cursor pagination.
Owen: compliance: need immutable audit export (NDJSON) for time windows. propose an export_for_audit endpoint that materializes snapshots into an org S3 path with signed URL.
Maya: include operator override action that logs operator id + mandatory reason. audit trail required.
Sam: question: allow per-tenant sampling controls or infra-only?
Owen: per-tenant sampling is important for enterprise tenants who pay for retention. defaults remain org-level.
Kai: replay determinism: include model commit/hash, quantization profile, and input hash in metadata so reruns are reproducible.
Jess: small UX detail: show a tiny sparkline per route for fallback rate trend so ops can triage at a glance.
Maya: next steps: Sam/Kai draft API schema + sampling config; Owen draft retention/export compliance; Jess mock compact inbox cards + actions. can we get a staging proto?
ComplianceBot: created compliance ticket COMP-847. retention matrix draft attached.
Sam: deploying a tiny prototype branch to staging this afternoon. will open a PR with schema & example payloads. tagging @Owen @Jess.
Owen: will add retention and export SLA notes to PR.
Maya: if all good, we'll roll out to a small canary set of tenants and observe operator workload and noise metrics. :thumbsup:
